clinical_rules.name: Toric IOL requires astigmatism
clinical_rules.description: Toric intraocular lenses are specifically designed to correct astigmatism. Billing toric IOL without documented astigmatism is inappropriate.

clinical_rules.name: SMILE is flapless
clinical_rules.description: SMILE (Small Incision Lenticule Extraction) doesn't create a corneal flap. Any flap-related charges indicate wrong procedure billing.

clinical_rules.name: Hair transplant graft limits
clinical_rules.description: Biological limits exist for single-session hair transplant. Exceeding 5000 grafts in FUE or 6000 in FUT is clinically improbable.

clinical_rules.name: Robotic surgery requires robotic consumables
clinical_rules.description: If robotic surgery is billed, robotic-specific consumables must be present. Robotic charges without consumables suggests non-robotic procedure billed as robotic.

clinical_rules.name: Bilateral procedures need bilateral implants
clinical_rules.description: Bilateral joint replacement or bilateral surgery must have two implant sets. Charging for bilateral procedure with single implant or vice versa is suspicious.

clinical_rules.name: Stent count verification
clinical_rules.description: Number of stents billed must match angiography findings. Billing 3 stents when angiography shows single vessel disease is suspicious.

clinical_rules.name: ICU stay clinically appropriate
clinical_rules.description: ICU duration should match procedure complexity. Minor procedures billing multiple ICU days is suspicious.

clinical_rules.name: OT duration consistency
clinical_rules.description: OT time billed should be consistent with procedure type. 8-hour OT charges for a 1-hour procedure is suspicious.

time_feasibility_rules.name: Duplicate consultation check
time_feasibility_rules.description: Same specialist consultation billed multiple times on same day for same procedure.
allowed_exceptions: pre-op and post-op on same day for different purposes

time_feasibility_rules.name: Surgery time overlap
time_feasibility_rules.description: Two surgeries billed with overlapping OT times - impossible unless different surgeons in different OTs.

time_feasibility_rules.name: Admission to surgery timing
time_feasibility_rules.description: Surgery performed before recorded admission time is impossible.

ghost_service_indicators.explanation: Robotic surgery requires specific expensive consumables. Their absence suggests procedure was conventional, not robotic.
Post-operative physiotherapy on day of major surgery is unusual for most procedures.
More than 3-4 different specialist consultations on a single day is unusual and may indicate ghost billing.
Billing for surgical consumables without the corresponding surgery charge.
